name: Proper Stable Sample Compression of the Three-Code Class
proof: Exhaustive enumeration of all proper stable unlabeled schemes on the realizable partial samples finds a size-two scheme and rules out every size-one scheme. The enumeration imposes sample consistency, reconstruction in $\mathcal C_{\triangle}$, and stability under deletion of an unselected example; it is recorded in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
